title: Assurance Tunnel — DPA Negotiation & Automated Audit Package
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: Customers frequently request bespoke DPA clauses, country-specific residency guarantees and time-boxed retention policies for audit purposes. Right now support and legal coordinate manually to collect evidence, run exports, and provide signed addenda — this is high-effort, error-prone, and slow for customers expanding into regulated geographies.

Problem statement: We need a end-to-end product flow that reduces time-to-fulfill for compliance requests from days/weeks to hours, while preserving legal correctness and security. The flow should: (1) let customers start a compliance request from Console or an API, (2) automate evidence packaging and chain-of-custody metadata, (3) surface negotiable DPA items with templated responses for legal, and (4) produce auditable export bundles that meet customer residency/retention constraints.

Proposal summary: Build an "Assurance Tunnel" feature in the Console and API that orchestrates DPA negotiation and generates a standardized audit package. Key capabilities: interactive DPA clause selector (customer-facing), automated evidence collector (logs, configuration, residency proofs), retention-tailored export generator (time-limited exports, redaction templates), and a legal-review workflow with suggested negotiable text and audit trail.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement on-prem installation for evidence collectors or long-term e-discovery tooling. It also does not replace enterprise legal negotiations — it accelerates and standardizes initial responses and provides artifacts for legal teams.

Minimum Viable Scope: Console flow + API endpoint for request creation, automated collection of: residency metadata (region of storage for keys), retention policy snapshot, audit logs (last 90 days), and policy-signed manifest. Legal templates for top 5 negotiable DPA clauses and a staging S3 export with TTL.
acceptance_criteria: Console: customer can create a 'Compliance Request' and select desired residency and retention constraints (region and retention period)
API: POST /compliance-requests returns request id and status with clear webhook for completion
Evidence collector aggregates required metadata and produces a signed manifest with sha256 checksums
Legal templates loaded: 5 negotiable DPA clauses with variable placeholders and audit history of edits
Automated export bundle generated and accessible via expiring URL (default TTL 72 hours) and a redactable CSV of user-facing records
End-to-end flow demonstrable in staging within 1 hour from request creation to downloadable audit bundle
success_metrics: Median time-to-fulfill for standard compliance requests reduced from 72 hours to <= 6 hours
Support load for compliance requests reduced by 40% within first quarter after launch
>90% of generated export bundles pass internal legal checklist on first attempt
Customer satisfaction NPS for compliance requests improves by at least 10 points for pilot customers
rollout_plan: Week 1: Prototype UI flow in Console + API contract, legal templates drafted with Legal
Week 2: Implement evidence collector agents (read-only) and manifest signing; internal demo
Week 3: Staging end-to-end test with 3 pilot customers and SRE performance validation
Week 4: Beta release to selected customers, collect feedback and iterate; prepare runbook for Support
Post-beta: Expand region proofs for EU and APAC, add additional retention redaction profiles
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Legal templates may not cover customer-specific clauses — Mitigation: Provide 'request escalation' flow to route to Legal with prefilled context
Risk: Export bundles could leak sensitive data — Mitigation: default to redactable exports, run automated PII scanner, require reviewer approval for full exports
Risk: Regional data proof generation varies by cloud provider — Mitigation: implement provider adapters and document gaps clearly in UI
